description: This file defines the IRuntimeManager interface and related structures for managing runtime containers, including lifecycle operations, notifications, and configuration within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IRuntimeManager
classes.description: Interface for managing runtime containers, including lifecycle control, notifications, and configuration.

classes.name: IRuntimeManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for runtime container events such as start, terminate, failure, and state change.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime environment parameters.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Start a runtime container with specified parameters and configuration.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wake the container to a specified runtime state.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieve information about the container, such as resource usage.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Send annotations or metadata to the container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mount a directory or device inside the container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmount a directory or device from the container.
